_comment: WI-tusad shrink-only ratchet over packages/hypergumbo-core/tests/test_stable_id_floor_gate.py's per-language fixture corpus. floor_and_null: per language and callable/member kind (GATED_KINDS), how many records ride the ADR-0035 backstop floor (id == make_declaration_stable_id(kind, language, path, name)) and how many are null. sibling_deletion_moves: the languages where deleting an earlier same-name sibling moved or nulled another symbol's stable_id. The gate fails on any count above this baseline (or a language it does not list) AND on any count below it: when a producer migrates to the ADR-0035 formula, ratchet the entry down in the same change (the failure message prints the live values). Never raise an entry. Target: both sections empty.
